column3: NASB renders “be denigrated” as “be spoken against” and adds “our.”
NASB renders “despise” as “be disrespectful to” and “exhort” as “preach,” and restructures the verse.
NASB renders “teaches another doctrine” as “advocates a different doctrine” and “draws near to” as “agree with.”
NASB renders “puffed up” as “conceited,” “unhealthy” as “has a morbid interest,” and “slander” as “abusive language.”
NASB follows the critical text without the Textus Receptus “from such withdraw yourself”; “corrupted” is rendered “depraved.”
NASB adds “actually” and “when accompanied by.”
NASB follows the critical text without “it is evident”; it adds “so” and “either.”
NASB renders “sustenance” as “food.”
NASB renders “desiring” as “want.”
NASB renders “were seduced away” as “have wandered away” and “many sorrows” as “many a pang.”
NASB follows the critical text (“gentleness”); “endurance” is rendered “perseverance.”
NASB follows the critical text without “also”; it adds “and you made.”
NASB follows the critical text; it reorders “before Pontius Pilate.”
NASB renders “without stain, above reproach” as “without stain or reproach.”
NASB renders “in His own seasons” as “at the proper time” and “will display” as “will bring about,” and sets the rest off with a dash.
NASB renders “dwelling in unapproachable light” as “dwells in unapproachable light” and begins new sentences.
NASB follows the critical text (“on God”) without “the living”; “present age” is rendered “present world,” and “providing” is “supplies.”
NASB adds “Instruct them.”
NASB follows the critical text (“life indeed”); it adds “the treasure of.”
NASB renders “the deposit” as “what has been entrusted to you” and “profane” as “worldly,” and puts “knowledge” in quotation marks.
NASB follows the critical text without “Amen” and the Textus Receptus subscription; it adds “thus.”
